text:
oncall-bot: ALERT: kube-apiserver liveness probe failing in eu-central-2 (eu-cp-2-01). 4 restarts in 8m. auto-escalate to eng-sre.

mika: seeing controller-manager leader flips and GPU node onboarding stuck. many pods in ContainerCreating.

jordan: any apiserver error lines?

sam: tail attached: 
```
I0318 12:04:11.123456 1 healthcheck.go:45] liveness probe failed: context deadline exceeded
E0318 12:04:11.456789 1 handler.go:212] GET /api/v1/namespaces/default/pods: etcdserver: request timed out
```

lee: etcd WAL fsync p95 spiked at 12:02 per metrics dashboard (etcd_disk_wal_fsync_duration_seconds_bucket). link: https://metrics/reports/etcd/eu-central-2

ana: NAT SNAT exhaustion was earlier at 11:50 but cleared. suspect noisy neighbor on NVMe host caused brief fsync tail latency. check host dmesg/iostat.

mika: kubectl get endpoints -n kube-system kube-apiserver shows eu-cp-2-01 missing.

jordan: controller-manager sees 500s during apiserver flaps -> frequent leader election -> onboarding controller retries amplify load. need to stop traffic to flapping instance.

sam: set LB weight 0 on eu-cp-2-01: `lbctl set-weight eu-cp-2-01 0`. errors dropped ~70% in 1m.

lee: good mitigation. collect iostat/dmesg and nvme SMART before recycle.

ana: prefer migrating disks off host or reprovision instead of scaling etcd followers. snapshots/sync risk. ops: eu-cp-2-01 oncall?

opsbot: ACTIONS: mitigate-lb-eu-cp-2-01, collect-host-logs-eu-cp-2-01, inspect-wal-eu-2-12:00-12:10. assignees: mika, sam, lee.

mika: opened infra ticket INF-6421 for nvme SMART + kernel logs. restarted kube-apiserver after logs captured.

jordan: short-term: LB routing + restart OK. long-term: consider smoothing apiserver liveness (increase threshold in this zone) and LB healthcheck grace to absorb WAL fsync spikes.

sam: this revealed coupling: onboarding controller's retry/backoff saturates apiserver under leader churn. propose adding backpressure or routing heavy onboarding to dedicated capacity to avoid affecting control plane.

lee: follow-ups: add host-level I/O alerts, investigate NVMe tail latency, consider apiserver liveness smoothing (5s->15s for eu-central-2), and add rate limit guard on onboarding controller.

mika: status: eu-cp-2-01 removed from LB, apiservers stable, controller-manager leaders steady, GPU onboarding backlog draining. monitoring for 2h.

ana: FYI finance — routing onboarding to dedicated capacity will raise short-term reserved usage.

opsbot: INCIDENT NOTE: mitigated via LB weight 0 + apiserver restart. follow-ups created: INF-6421, SRE-6153 (apiserver-liveness), SRE-6154 (onboarding-rate-limit).

mika: thanks all, will draft postmortem once SMART logs confirm NVMe stalls. tagging eng-ml and product for customer impact note. :thumbsup:
